d:
Under the fading sunset on set, she remains the flawless heroine everyone admires.
But once Kazuya turns away, Mizuhara Chizuru walks alone through that closed door — where “industry connections” become a price she cannot refuse.

The truth behind the sponsorship and success is known only to her and that man.
While love and trust remain in the dark, her body becomes the currency paid again and again.

It is a night where even her smile carries the weight of guilt.
